description.narrative: The objective of the Pacific Aviation Investment Project for East Asia and Pacific is to improve operational safety and oversight of international air transport infrastructure. This regional project was prepared covering the Republic of Kiribati, Kingdom of Tonga, and Tuvalu. The components for Republic of Kiribati are: (1) International airport infrastructure investments component which will invest in the aviation infrastructure at Kiribati?s international airports; (2) Sector reform and training component will finance technical assistance to the MCTTD and other ministries; (3) Strengthening airport operations and management capacity component will finance technical assistance for the establishment of an independent public entity for the management of Kiribati?s airports and its operation; and (4) Project support component will finance the provision of technical, advisory and administrative support to MCTTD. Components for Kingdom of Tonga are: (1) Aviation infrastructure investments component which will invest in the aviation infrastructure at Fua?amotu and Vava?u airports; (2) Aviation sector reform and training component will provide the technical assistance to TAL, the MOT and other ministries; (3) Strengthening airport operations and management capacity component will co-ordinate three studies related to improving the regional aviation market in the Pacific Island Countries and increasing revenues from the flight information regions; (4) Project support component will finance the provision of technical, advisory and administrative support to TAL and other ministries. Components for Tuvalu are: (1) Aviation infrastructure investments component will invest in the aviation infrastructure at Funafuti international airport; (2) Aviation sector reform and training component will provide technical assistance to the MTC and other ministries; (3) Strengthening airport operations and management capacity component will support sustainable operation of Funafuti airport; (4) Project support component will finance the provision of technical, advisory and administrative support to MTC and other ministries.
The project development objective is to improve the safety and security of air transport and associated infrastructure.

title.narrative: Component A: Intermediate Result indicator Two: Rehabilitation of Funafuti runway

comment.narrative: <p>Runway repair works yet to be completed due to failed bids until project completion.</p>

title.narrative: Component A: Intermediate Result indicator One: Navigation and safety aids fully operational

comment.narrative: <p>ADS-B was installed but at completion was inoperative awaiting maintenance. Other Navigation aids including VSAT damaged in a fire incident. Fire truck was delivered and operational at completion.</p>

title.narrative: Component A: Intermediate Result indicator Four: Funafuti terminal and control tower upgrade

comment.narrative: <p>A new Funafuti terminal and control tower with fire truck shed were successfully constructed.</p>

title.narrative: Indicator Two: Resolution of safety concerns at participating airports reaches global ICAO average

comment.narrative: <p>ICAO Universal Safety Oversight Audit Program (USOAP)was not conducted where countries are given an ‘Effective Implementation’ (EI) score out of 100, this indicator remains unchanged. However, some of the safety concerns identified by the baseline inspection were rectified such as upgrading of both the terminal and the control tower and upgrading fire service coverage to ICAO category 5.</p>

title.narrative: Indicator One: Certification of safety and security at project airports

target.value: Certification of airports in accordance with agreed goals

comment.narrative: <p>FUN was not certified by ICAO. It currently holds a provisional certificate from ICAO's regional representative, PASO. </p>

title.narrative: Indicator Three: Modernization of air traffic management

comment.narrative: <p>ADS-B was successfully installed. VSAT equipment to connect Tuvalu to the aviation satellite network for the pacific (PASnet) was installed but was damaged in a fire incident.</p>

actual.value: ADS-B operational. VSAT equipment not functional.

title.narrative: Indicator Four: Implementation of a regional safety levy for international passengers

target.value: AU$5 collected from each departing international passenger

comment.narrative: <p>Regional safety Levy collection from international passengers of AU$5 has successfully been implemented.</p>

actual.value: Levy being collected. Funds now being received by GoTv

title.narrative: Component A: Intermediate Results Indicator Six: Construction of storage facility under the terminal for water runoff to prevent flooding during heavy rainfall exacerbated by climate change

comment.narrative: <p>Construction of storage facility under the terminal for water runoff to prevent flooding during heavy rainfall exacerbated by climate change was completed.</p>

title.narrative: Component A - Intermediate Result indicator Five: Number of kilometers of paved roads improved

comment.narrative: <p>Entire classified road network of 15.4km successfully rehabilitated.</p>
<p>7.4 km of non-rural on Funafuti atoll successfully rehabilitated.</p>
<p>8kms of rural road on Funafuti successfully rehabilitated.</p>

title.narrative: Roads in good and fair condition as a share of total classified roads

comment.narrative: <p>100 percent of classified road network(15.4km) on Funafuti successfully rehabilitated.</p>

title.narrative: Component A - Intermediate Indicator Seven: Implementation of repair and resiliency works for FUN runway

comment.narrative: <p>A study was conducted on impact of sea level rise on coastal pavement infrastructure. The works were not implemented by project completion.</p>

comment.narrative: <p>Runway works bid was unsuccessful. At project completion, the contractor was not engaged.</p>
